# Locked grid bodies and header toolbars ignore the grid's configs

## Context

Found while testing #6858 (AnimateRows) on a grid with a locked column: the locked body never loads the plugin, so its rows cannot move with the center body's.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` at `7f0856c106` in the unit harness, on a grid with a locked `id` column, `body: {animatedRowSorting: true, highlightModifiedCells: true}` and `headerToolbar: {showHeaderFilters: true}`:

| Instance | `animatedRowSorting` | `highlightModifiedCells` | `showHeaderFilters` |
|---|---|---|---|
| center body | true | true | |
| locked start body | **false** | **false** | |
| center header toolbar | | | true |
| locked start header toolbar | | | **false** |

So in every grid with locked columns, the locked regions ignore the grid's `body` and `headerToolbar` configs: locked columns get no header filters, no sorting options (`sortable`, `useTriStateSorting`), no row animation, no modified-cell highlighting, and no other setting passed there.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/Container.mjs#createOrUpdateSubGrids` builds `bodyStart` and `bodyEnd` from `...me.body.initialConfig`, and `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs` builds `headerStart` and `headerEnd` from `...headerToolbar.initialConfig`. Both came with the multi-body layout (#9487, 2026-03-31).
- `initialConfig` is assigned nowhere in `src`. Core records an instance's construction config as `originalConfig` (`src/core/Base.mjs`, `Neo.clone(config, true, true)`), so each spread is of `undefined`.
- The center body's `originalConfig` holds the merged grid defaults and user keys (`parentId`, `store`, `theme`, `animatedRowSorting`, `highlightModifiedCells` in the probe); the header toolbar's holds `parentId`, `showHeaderFilters`, `sortable`, `theme`, `useTriStateSorting`. The keys after each spread already override the instance-specific ones (`parentId`, `store`, `theme`, `gridContainer`, `windowId`, `flex`, `layoutLock`, `items`).

## The Fix

Build each locked instance from the center instance's `originalConfig`, without its ids. `Neo.cloneNeoInstance` already does exactly that, so it takes an optional second argument for the configs the region owns, and both sites call it (this replaces the first prescription, an inline spread of `originalConfig`). Test each surface: a locked body inherits a `body` config value, a locked header toolbar inherits a `headerToolbar` config value, and, deferred from #6858, a locked body moves its rows with the center body under `animatedRowSorting`.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

The `config` argument is new; the helper had one argument. | This ticket | Creates an instance of `instance.className`, so a subclass stays a subclass, from a copy of `instance.originalConfig` without `_id` and `id`, with `config` spread over it. A key in `config` replaces the original value whole (no deep merge), and a caller may pass any key on purpose, `id` included. | `originalConfig` is the construction snapshot `core.Base#mergeConfig` records (`Neo.clone(config, true, true)`): the configs the instance was created with, not its live state. A value set after construction does not carry over, and nothing reaches the clone later. Nested objects and arrays in the snapshot are copies; Neo instances in it are shared, so a clone that needs its own passes it in `config`. An instance without `originalConfig` (`preventOriginalConfig`) clones from `config` alone. | JSDoc of `cloneNeoInstance` | `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs` › "Neo.cloneNeoInstance applies the given configs over the original ones and drops the id" |
| `Neo.clone(instance)` (`src/Neo.mjs`, `cloneMap.NeoInstance`) | Existing | Unchanged: calls `cloneNeoInstance(instance)` without configs, so `config` is `{}`. | Pre-existing since #6951 and unchanged here: `Neo.clone` hands `NeoInstance` its `deep` flag where that expects `ignoreNeoInstances`. So `Neo.clone(instance, true)` returns the same instance and `Neo.clone(instance, false, true)` a new one, the reverse of the docs; the snapshot call (`true, true`) shares instances either way. | — | The same test clones through `Neo.clone(instance)` |

The region sets its own `flex: 'none'`, `gridContainer`, `parentId` (the view), `reference: null`, `rowHeight`, `store`, `theme`, `useInternalId` and `windowId`. | Cloned when its region gets a locked column, and kept while it has one. A region that empties destroys its body; its next locked column clones a new one from the same snapshot. A later `set()` on the center body reaches no locked body (Out of Scope). | Inline comment | AC-1, AC-3 and AC-4 arms |
| `headerStart`, `headerEnd` (`grid.header.Wrapper#updateHeaders`) | #9487, this ticket | A locked header toolbar clones the center toolbar (`headerToolbar`): its class, and the configs it was created with (the grid's `headerToolbar` config). The region sets its own `flex: 'none'`, `gridContainer`, `items` (its locked buttons), `layoutLock`, `parentId` (the wrapper), `reference: null`, `theme` and `windowId`. | Cloned when its region gets a locked column; an existing locked toolbar takes new buttons through `items` and `createItems()`. A region that empties moves its buttons, then destroys its toolbar. Same construction-only boundary. | Inline comment | AC-2 and AC-3 arms |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1 With locked start and end columns, `bodyStart` and `bodyEnd` carry the grid's `body` config values (pinned: `animatedRowSorting`, `highlightModifiedCells`).
- [x] AC-2 `headerStart` and `headerEnd` carry the grid's `headerToolbar` config values (pinned: `showHeaderFilters`, `sortable`, `useTriStateSorting`).
- [x] AC-3 No instance-specific key carries over: ids stay unique, and `parentId`, `store` and `theme` come from the explicit keys.
- [x] AC-4 With `animatedRowSorting` and a locked column, every record's row sits at the same offset in the locked and the center body at both steps of a move.
- [x] AC-5 The unit, component and e2e suites pass.

Evidence for each: #19777 at `7c07b98906`, its *AC Evidence* table. AC-4 also holds in the browser: `examples/grid/animatedRowSorting` locks its Id column, and `AnimatedRowSorting.spec.mjs` fails on `dev`'s source (the locked row jumps while the center row animates) and passes with the fix.

## Out of Scope

- Changing the center body's or header toolbar's configs at runtime: the locked instances do not follow a later `set()`, before or after this fix.
- `Neo.clone`'s `ignoreNeoInstances` argument (Contract Ledger, second row): every deep clone relies on keeping nested instances, so a fix is its own decision.
